title: introduce-modular-rag-studio-lite-quickstart
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a compact, modular RAG Studio quickstart aimed at developer demos and offline authoring. Motivation: we frequently field requests for a lightweight, dependency-minimal sandbox that demonstrates tool-calling, incremental indexing, and scenario-driven evaluations without needing heavy infra. This quickstart targets two personas: 1) engineers who want a reproducible local demo for product meetings and 2) contributors who need an isolated harness for writing scenario-based evals. Change summary: 1) new CLI scaffolder (bin/mini-rag) that bootstraps a tiny web UI, an in-memory incremental indexer, and a WASM-based tool stub runtime; 2) compact devcontainer and Docker profile for one-command local runs; 3) a small set of authored scenarios (samples/) with step assertions and a recorder that captures model/tool interactions for playback; 4) lightweight telemetry stub that emits structured events to a local file for debugging; 5) documentation pages (docs/quickstarts/mini-rag-studio.md) and a short HowTo for embedding the quickstart into demos. Backwards compatibility: the quickstart is entirely self-contained under quickstarts/mini-rag-studio and does not change global CLI commands. Security: no remote telemetry by default; all network calls are disabled in dev mode except optional feature flags. Runbook + checklist included in the description. See commits and changed files for details.
commits: Initial scaffold: add mini-rag CLI, basic web UI skeleton, and package.json
Add in-memory incremental indexer and sample indexer adapter
Implement WASM tool shim and example tool scripts
Add scenario recorder, playback runner, and sample scenarios with assertions
Add devcontainer, Docker profile, and a compact README for one-command launch
Docs: add quickstarts/mini-rag-studio.md and usage guide
Fix lint, add CI smoke test to run quickstart in headless mode
Address review feedback: tighten telemetry, add feature flag for network, update error messages

release_notes: Introduce ‘mini RAG Studio’ quickstart: lightweight local sandbox demonstrating incremental indexing, WASM-based tool stubs, scenario recorder/playback, and a one-command devcontainer run. Intended for demos, contributor onboarding, and writing scenario-based evals.
